tldr: Mars in Leo: action is creative, bold, and fueled by pride in the work.
body: With Mars in Leo, drive wants expression, recognition, and a worthy stage. You act best when courage, play, and purpose are all involved.
gift: Creative initiative, passion, leadership, and the stamina to perform under pressure.
challenge: Ego battles, drama, and confusing being seen with being respected.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
